sections.name: goal
sections.value: Ship Pij Emergent Communities (PEC): a per-project directory of roles that outlive their seats, grown from what the work needs and reshaped as it changes, with memory, outputs, routing and prompts for the prime.

value.title: Docs system and the community PRD
value.done_when: Schemas resolve; this PRD, its blueprint and this roadmap validate clean; `ddocs graph` draws the joins.

value.title: Role schema, layout and the governance writer
value.done_when: `pij directory add` writes a validated role on the governance branch, refuses by name without governance or ddocs, and the cost row is measured.

value.title: Core and security templates
value.done_when: A new directory prompts for the five core roles and security and creates nothing (C22); a role made from a template records it; a template bump shows a diff.

value.title: Assign, release, lineage and the directory view
value.done_when: Lineage survives a store rebuild; the view lists roles and holders for this project only.

value.title: Send to a role, the role queue and reply modes
value.done_when: The 0, 1 and 2 holder cases, instances, the PA wake and the three reply modes behave as the PRD says.

value.title: Outputs and notification
value.done_when: Parallel outputs never conflict; the requester is notified in its chosen mode.

value.title: Role memory and its prompts
value.done_when: Notes are one file each with a generated INDEX.md, and a role holder's compact and close are each preceded by the memory turn.

value.title: Routing table
value.done_when: ROUTES.md regenerates on a scope change and reaches seats at the four triggers.

value.title: Prime prompts
value.done_when: Each prompt condition shows with its runnable command.

value.title: Number claims and delivery at merge
value.done_when: Parallel claims never collide, and a merged PR's delivery shows on the requirement and the PM's card.

value.title: Time limits and check-ins
value.done_when: The three req-22 cases behave as written, with no new timer or launch.

value.title: Doc procedures and examples in the skill
value.done_when: A fresh PM writes a valid, linked PRD and roadmap from the procedure.

value.title: Triage pij's earlier register into PRD 002
value.done_when: PRD 002 validates under docs/project/prds/ and every open row of the earlier register has a recorded verdict.

value.title: Community skill route and optional templates
value.done_when: A fresh prime follows the route and stands up a working community.
